ditra.spec: Bond DITRA with ANSI A118.11 modified thin-set over plywood/OSB; unmodified A118.1 over concrete or gypsum. Tile over DITRA: Schluter SET, ALL-SET, FAST-SET, or unmodified A118.1 (Schluter advises against other brands' modified mortars here due to slow cure).

ditraheat.spec: Tile over DITRA-HEAT: Schluter SET, ALL-SET, FAST-SET, or unmodified A118.1. Moisture-sensitive stone (e.g., green marble) may need special setting materials.

kerdi.spec: Bond with Schluter SET/ALL-SET/FAST-SET or unmodified thin-set; seams 2 in overlap or KERDI-BAND. Suitable for showers and intermittent-use steam showers (0.90 perms).

kerdids.spec: Required by Schluter for continuous-use steam rooms (0.18 perms, ASTM E96 Proc. E).

redgard.spec: Meets ANSI A118.10 and A118.12 high performance (cracks to 1/8 in); IAPMO shower pan liner; 0.35 perms at steam spec (<0.5 required); steam showers applied 40–45 mils per TB40 (follow TCNA SR614/SR615).

aqua.spec: Exceeds A118.10-LV and A118.12; IAPMO shower-pan liner; 0.35 perms. MAPEI's installation guide states a vapor barrier is required with it in steam rooms; not for OSB.

hydroban.spec: Meets/exceeds A118.10 and A118.12; tile over with A118.4, A118.15 or A118.3 adhesive. LATICRETE lists HYDRO BAN, HYDRO BAN Sheet Membrane, Quick Cure and 9235 for steam rooms with compatible LATICRETE thin-sets.

porcelain.mortar: Modified ANSI A118.4 or improved modified A118.15 mortar (e.g., LATICRETE 254 Platinum exceeds A118.4/A118.11/A118.15).
porcelain.trowel: CUSTOM chart: 1/4×1/4×1/4 in square notch for tile up to 8 in; 1/4×3/8×1/4 in square notch for 8–16 in. Confirm coverage by pulling tiles.
porcelain.frost: Porcelain is ≤0.5% absorption (impervious) but only the manufacturer can rate a tile for exterior; look for ASTM C1026 freeze-thaw results.

ceramic.mortar: ANSI A118.4 modified mortar generally. Use of A118.1 dry-set for interior wall tile not confirmed from a source here. [verify]
ceramic.trowel: CUSTOM chart: 1/4×1/4×1/4 in square notch up to 8 in; 1/4×3/8×1/4 in square notch 8–16 in.
ceramic.frost: TCNA: absorption alone doesn't predict frost performance (3% tiles have failed C1026; some 5–7% passed); only the manufacturer can rate a tile for exterior use.

stone.mortar: ANSI A118.4/A118.15 mortar; white mortar for light marble. Moisture-sensitive stone (e.g., green marble) may require special setting materials such as epoxy — ask stone supplier. [verify]
stone.trowel: Ungauged stone may require larger notch sizes and flat back-troweling (CUSTOM).
stone.note: Deflection: L/720 for natural stone over wood framing (TCNA assemblies / MIA) vs L/360 for ceramic. Stone over wood with backer board: TCNA F250 — 19/32 in T&G ply subfloor + 15/32 in ply underlayment (residential), joists max 16 in o.c.
stone.frost: Exterior suitability is stone-specific — check with stone supplier. [verify]

glass.mortar: White, non-sanded glass-tile mortar meeting ANSI A118.15 (e.g., LATICRETE Glass Tile Adhesive Lite). Follow the glass tile maker's approved list.
glass.trowel: Trowel per glass tile manufacturer; no independent source confirmed here. [verify]
glass.note: ANSI A108.15 covers paper-faced glass mosaic. In steam rooms LATICRETE suggests HYDRO BAN Cementitious membrane then Glass Tile Adhesive, 254 Platinum, 257 Titanium, or LATAPOXY 300.
glass.frost: Exterior use only where glass tile maker rates it. [verify]

lft.mortar: Tile with any side >15 in or >5 lb/ft²: LHT mortar meeting A118.4H or A118.15H (bond coat 3/32–1/2 in after embedding). Gauged porcelain tile panels/slabs: ANSI A108.19 (interior) / A108.20 (exterior), mortar per panel maker.
lft.trowel: Ridge-collapsing notch (U, slant, LFT), e.g., 3/4×9/16×3/8 in U-notch at 30° (CUSTOM); CUSTOM advises against 1/2×1/2 in square; back-trowel as needed. Panel-specific trowel/back-butter: per panel maker.
lft.note: TCNA: LHT mortar cannot be used to level or flatten substrates or build slopes.
lft.frost: Exterior GPTP per ANSI A108.20; tile must be manufacturer-rated for exterior.

mosaic.mortar: ANSI A118.4 or A118.15 modified mortar; for glass mosaics see Glass.
mosaic.trowel: 3/16×5/32 in V-notch for tile up to 6×6 in (TEC/H.B. Fuller data sheet, premixed adhesive — confirm with your thinset's data sheet).
mosaic.frost: Depends on mosaic body — manufacturer must rate for exterior.

slab.notes: Honor movement joints through tile. Crack isolation membranes per ANSI A118.12 / installed per A108.17.
slab.mtag: Crack isolation (A118.12) over shrinkage cracks; DITRA bonded with unmodified A118.1 over concrete.

plywood.notes: TCNA 2023 wood floor assemblies (per Boise Cascade summary): most limit joists to 16 in o.c. (3 allow 19.2 in, 6 allow 24 in). Examples: F148 — 23/32 in ext-glue T&G ply + uncoupling membrane at 19.2 in o.c.; F147 — 23/32 in ply + 3/8 in ply underlayment at 24 in o.c. Deflection L/360 ceramic, L/720 stone. Exterior-glue plywood only; not over particle board, luan or interior-glue ply.
plywood.mtag: Uncoupling membrane (DITRA bonded with A118.11 modified over plywood) or cement backer per the chosen TCNA method.
plywood.mortarAdj: Mortar must be rated for exterior-glue plywood (A118.11).

cbu.notes: Cement board is not waterproof — add a bonded A118.10 membrane in wet areas.

existing.notes: Existing tile must be sound, well bonded and cleaned/scarified; mortar must list existing ceramic tile as a substrate. The Ceramic Tile Foundation advises against tile-over-tile in continuous-use steam showers (existing vapor barrier can't be verified; second membrane may trap moisture) — full tear-out recommended.
existing.mtag: Membrane over existing tile: check membrane data sheet for existing-tile substrate and primer/skim-coat requirements. [verify]

heated.notes: Install cables per heat maker; with DITRA, cables are encapsulated in ALL-SET/FAST-SET/modified thin-set or leveler, cured, then DITRA set with SET or unmodified mortar. DITRA-HEAT holds cables without leveler.

floor.cov: Min 80% average contact; corners and edges supported.

shower.cov: 95% average contact, corners and edges fully supported (ANSI A108.5).
shower.req: Bonded waterproofing membrane meeting ANSI A118.10 required — mortars are not waterproofing.

steam.req: Low-perm membrane (<0.5 perms, ASTM E96 Proc. E) per TCNA SR613 (continuous) / SR614 (intermittent). KERDI: intermittent only; KERDI-DS for continuous. RedGard at 40–45 mils. AquaDefense needs separate vapor barrier in steam rooms.

exterior.req: Tile must be manufacturer-rated for exterior/freeze-thaw (ASTM C1026); provide drainage — standing water and ice in joints damage even frost-resistant tile. Waterproofing over occupied space; AquaDefense is not for use as primary membrane over occupied space.
